summary: Joe Anderson, 45, Englewood mayor pro tem, lost consciousness and stopped breathing on the lower slopes of Quandary Peak ~6:40 a.m.; other hikers began CPR before Summit County Sheriff's deputies and medical personnel took over; he died at the scene (official cause of death pending coroner determination).
notes: Parks the run-643 SCSO-blotter 'Quandary Trail ~1-mi hiker fatality (fall or medical, bystander CPR unsuccessful)' lead (cross-anchored via SCSO statements in news coverage; 2026-08-28 Friday-verified). Row date = occurrence date per Aug. 28 City of Englewood release ('died this morning').
